children: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Thursday said it will start a mission in Argentina the week of September 21 for the third review of the country's current program.
Key priorities for Argentina include continuing to rebuild reserves, reduce financing risks and preserve the fiscal anchor, the IMF added.
